preconditions.description: The number of affected settlements m must be between 1 and n, and n must not exceed 100000.
The damage range d must be between 0 and n - 1.

preconditions.expression: len(set(p)) == m and all(1 <= pi <= n for pi in p)
preconditions.description: The affected settlements must be distinct and within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of settlements that may contain the Book of Evil.
